Overview

Hampton is a city in VA with a population of 135,000. Hampton Roads city with Langley Air Force Base and the Hampton Coliseum. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees.
